# Data Layout and Path Conventions

## Directory Structure

`data/` and `output/` live **inside the repo** and are git-ignored. `data_dir` and `output_dir` in the config are resolved relative to the repo root by `run_notebooks.py` / `lib/setup_run.py`.

```
PUB-framework-Alfonso/
├── config/
│   ├── notebook_parameters_default.yml   ← base defaults
│   ├── alfonso_baseline.yml
│   ├── clennett_baseline.yml
│   ├── zahirovic_baseline.yml
│   └── .run_config.yml                   ← resolved at runtime; read by all notebooks
├── data/                                 ← git-ignored
│   ├── {plate_model_name}/               ← e.g. alfonso2024_default, zahirovic2022
│   │   ├── plate_model/                  ← .rot, .gpml files (PMM-fetched or provided)
│   │   ├── rasters/                      ← generated by 00a
│   │   │   ├── SeafloorAge/
│   │   │   ├── SpreadingRate/
│   │   │   ├── SedimentThickness/
│   │   │   ├── CarbonateThickness/
│   │   │   ├── CrustalCO2/
│   │   │   ├── CrustalThickness/
│   │   │   └── ErosionDeposition/
│   │   ├── mantle_outputs/               ← G-ADOPT netCDF outputs
│   │   │   └── {gadopt_run_name}/        ← e.g. v1_pre_craton_fix
│   │   └── extracted_data/
│   │       └── {reference_feature}_{study_zone_buffer}_deg_buffer/
│   │           └── ...                   ← see Extracted Data section below
│   └── deposits/
│       ├── deposits.csv                  ← Alfonso 2024 original deposit list
│       └── deposits-Etherington.csv      ← extended deposit DB (Zahirovic2022 runs)
├── output/                               ← git-ignored
│   └── {run_name}/
│       ├── config_snapshot.yml
│       └── global/
│           ├── PU/
│           ├── SVM/
│           └── feature_selection/
└── regions.geojson                       ← static study area geometry; repo root
```

> `plate_model_name` is the config key used throughout — e.g. `alfonso2024_default`, `zahirovic2022`. It names both the PMM model to fetch and the `data/` subdirectory.

## Extracted Data

Extracted data is a shared cache — it depends on reconstruction and reference feature, not on training config. Any run with matching parameters can reference it without re-extraction.

```
data/{plate_model_name}/extracted_data/{reference_feature}_{buffer}_deg_buffer/
    ├── metadata.json
    ├── study_area_polygons/
    │   └── study_area_{NNN}Ma.geojson
    ├── points/
    │   ├── labelled_deposits.csv
    │   ├── unlabelled_points.csv
    │   └── prediction_grid.csv
    ├── subducting_plate_features.csv
    ├── raster_features.csv
    └── mantle_features_{gadopt_run_name}.csv
```

## Config Key → Path Mapping

All derived paths are constructed by notebooks from the base config keys. Never hardcode them.

| Config key / derived path | Value / pattern |
|---|---|
| `data_dir` | resolved to absolute by `run_notebooks.py` (default: `{repo_root}/data`) |
| `output_dir` | resolved to absolute by `run_notebooks.py` (default: `{repo_root}/output`) |
| `plate_model_name` | names both PMM model and `data/{plate_model_name}/` subdirectory |
| `recon_data_dir` | `{data_dir}/{plate_model_name}/` |
| `plate_model_dir` | `{data_dir}/{plate_model_name}/plate_model/` |
| `raster_data_dir` | `{data_dir}/{plate_model_name}/rasters/` |
| `extracted_data_dir` | `{data_dir}/{plate_model_name}/extracted_data/{reference_feature}_{study_zone_buffer}_deg_buffer/` |
| `mantle_data_dir` | `{data_dir}/{plate_model_name}/mantle_outputs/{gadopt_run_name}/` |
| `run_output_dir` | `{output_dir}/{run_name}/` |
| `deposits_dir` | `{data_dir}/deposits/` |

## File Naming Conventions

- Rasters: `{variable}_{NNN}Ma.nc` — zero-padded 3-digit age (e.g. `seafloor_age_010Ma.nc`)
- G-ADOPT outputs: `{plate_model_name}_gadopt_{NNN}Ma.nc`
- Study area polygons: `study_area_{NNN}Ma.geojson`
- Mantle feature CSVs: `mantle_features_{gadopt_run_name}.csv` — keyed by run to avoid overwriting

## Deposit Schema

| Column | Used for |
|---|---|
| `Lat`, `Lon` | Present-day coordinates |
| `Recon_Age_Ma` | Reconstruction age (`null→0`, plate-age corrected) |
| `Plate_ID` | GPlates plate ID |
| `Ore_Tonnage_Mt` | Sample weighting (not yet activated) |
| `Cu_Tonnage_Mt` | Maps to `Cu (Mt)` in `lib/pu.py` (not yet activated) |
| `DepositGroup` | Porphyry / VMS / SedCu / IOCG |

Mapping to Alfonso's internal schema: `Lon→lon`, `Lat→lat`, `Recon_Age_Ma→age (Ma)`, `label="positive"`.
